issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide method signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template example use messageOnRide() with no parameters, but the solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and the implementations in Pig and Seal also require an equipment parameter. This mismatch will cause confusion and compilation errors when students follow the problem/template API but compare to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable API consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) remove the equipment parameter from the solution: change Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) to Rideable.messageOnRide() and update Pig and Seal implementations to match (returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"), or (B) update the problem statement and template examples to require an equipment parameter and adjust the described return string accordingly. Option A is preferred to match the current specification and template usage.
